processes.name: Counterparty price and volume discrepancy queries to gas logistics
processes.description: Settlements and accounting staff email Daren Farmer when a counterparty invoice or meter statement disagrees with the Sitara deal price, volume or counterparty. He or a delegate checks the deal book or the trader and corrects Sitara, then replies by email.
processes.stall_points: Requests sit unanswered until chased, and the answer often needs a trader or a deal book. Some questions are resent weeks later.
processes.automation: Compare Sitara deal prices against invoice and meter data automatically and route each mismatch to the deal owner with the evidence attached. Track open queries and escalate them.

I found Danny's book and he has the deal priced at 5.25.  I adjusted the price in Sitara.  Let me know if anything further is needed.
Could you fix asap because payment is due on 25th.

processes.name: Missing deal or expired contract blocking sales settlement
processes.description: Settlement accountants find that counterparty-supported volumes have no deal or that a deal will not flow to Unify. They email around to find who owns the deal, then ask for a deal or contract extension. The chain passes through many people.
processes.stall_points: The question is forwarded between four to six people, each saying to ask someone else. The fix is then undone by a contract-level problem that needs another group.
processes.automation: Match counterparty volume support to deals automatically and flag volumes with no deal. Surface contract expiry before month-end settlement.

evidence.quote: I did a search and found no deals for May for this counterparty.  Call Daren Farmer at 713-853-6905, and he could probably put the deal in for you.

processes.name: Cowtrap/Blue Dolphin allocation and Dow invoice resolution
processes.description: Settlements staff chase a missing allocation in Volume Management and the invoice price for the Dow Cowtrap and Blue Dolphin sales. They go back and forth with the customer on the price, a payment date and a corrected invoice.
processes.stall_points: Volume Management shows no detail while the nomination was tracked and balanced, so people wait on each other against a payment deadline. The invoice price is disputed by a cent and must be reissued.
processes.automation: Alert when an allocation has no volume actualisation before the payment cut-off. Validate invoice price against the deal before it is sent.

processes.name: Daily credit report forwarding
processes.description: Darron Giron receives the daily Credit Report email, which lists counterparty rebooks and pending TAGG actions. He forwards each one to Carole Frank, who handles the actions.
processes.stall_points: The report arrives by email each day and is forwarded by hand. The rebook actions are then done manually in TAGG.
processes.automation: Route the credit report to the book admin automatically and extract the TAGG numbers and actions into a work list.

processes.name: TAGG book administration and trade correction requests
processes.description: Darron Giron handles requests to maintain TAGG books, trading groups and book admin assignments, and to fix errors on booked trades. He covers for Carole Frank on trade corrections.
processes.stall_points: Changes need a second person with access to the web site or trading group. Each change is a separate email thread.
processes.automation: Provide a self-service request form for book admin and trading group changes, with an audit trail. Validate trade term and counterparty against broker confirms automatically.

processes.name: Portland real-time desk length and schedule notices
processes.description: Bill Williams emails the Portland shift group each day with the group's long position, which book to enter it under, and schedule entry instructions. He also sends corrections for schedules entered wrongly by the CISO.
processes.stall_points: Positions and book instructions are typed into an email each day. Shift staff must then re-key them into CAPS, Enpower and the service sheets.
processes.automation: Generate the daily length notice from the position system and post it to the shift channel. Auto-populate CAPS and the service sheets.

processes.name: Misdirected mail and distribution list corrections for Bill Williams
processes.description: Reports, model files and requests meant for the other Bill Williams reach Bill Williams III. He forwards them back and asks senders to correct their lists, and updates the list of people who receive the real-time deal spreadsheets.
processes.stall_points: Each sender has to be told separately, and the same mix-up recurs with new senders.
processes.automation: Maintain one authoritative distribution list and flag ambiguous names. Auto-update the EES spreadsheet recipient list.

processes.name: EPGT pipeline pathing and pool clean-up
processes.description: Gas accounting asks Daren Farmer and the logistics group to path deals and fix interconnect volumes for old months on the EPGT pipe. Later, Shane Lakho works through error messages and terminates unused pools in Unify.
processes.stall_points: Open items sit for weeks, as with February 2000, and need repeated follow-ups. Each pathing fix is requested one deal at a time by email.
processes.automation: Track open pathing exceptions in a queue with owners and ageing. Check interconnect volumes against invoices automatically.

processes.name: Customer nomination and deal change requests to HPL logistics
processes.description: Commercial staff email Daren Farmer and colleagues to change nominations, extend deal tickets or roll volumes. Examples are Imperial Sugar volumes, Guadalupe deals rolled into June and deal ticket 745546. The logistics team then makes the nomination or deal change.
processes.stall_points: Requests arrive as free-text email and need judgement on pricing. Replies and confirmations are by email.
processes.automation: Provide a structured nomination change form that creates the Sitara change request and logs approval.
